blocks.text: Sahara (support) aur harkat (movement) insani biology ke bunyadi pehlu hain. In hi ki wajah se hum seedhe chalne phirne se le kar mushkil kaamon tak bohat si sargarmiyan kar sakte hain. Is chapter mein haddiyon (bones) aur cartilage ki banawat parhenge, jo jism ko zaroori sahara dene wala dhancha (framework) deti hain. Hum mukhtalif qism ke jor (joints) dekhenge, aur teen qism ke muscles (pathon), yani skeletal, smooth aur cardiac, ki khaas baatein dekhenge jo harkat paida karte hain. Muscle ke sukarne ko molecule ki satah par samajhne ke liye sliding filament model parhenge. Is ke ilawa skeletal aur muscular systems ki aam bimariyan aur insani sehat aur chalne phirne par un ka asar bhi dekhenge.

Haddiyan, cartilage aur doosre connective tissues (jorne wale tissues) mil kar jism ke andar ek dhancha banate hain jise skeleton kehte hain. Skeleton jism ko sahara deta hai, ahem aza (organs) ki hifazat karta hai, aur harkat aur chalne phirne (locomotion) mein madad deta hai.
